scope: Pre-final-copy source and screenshots; no blocker; two nonblocking usability findings
result:
UI consistency/usability: **8/10**. No blocking code regression found in the scoped changes. Reviewed all three supplied screenshots and browser-results.json; no browser or service access performed.

Two nonblocking usability findings:

- **Owner-only setup is disclosed after the main instructions.** Step 3 directs visitors to Google sign-in before explaining that ordinary accounts cannot fetch playlists. Put the owner restriction directly in that step and offer JSON import there as the usable alternative. [page.tsx:36](src/app/macos/page.tsx:36), [page.tsx:170](src/app/macos/page.tsx:170).
- **Transfer guidance is dense and buried in an accordion.** The JSON path is especially relevant while fresh imports are owner-only. A short visible “Bring your browser library” instruction would improve discovery; keep detailed exclusions in the FAQ. [page.tsx:49](src/app/macos/page.tsx:49).

The captures show consistent dark styling, clear hierarchy, readable installation columns and a workable 320px layout. Source provides semantic headings, accessible navigation labels, decorative-icon hiding and visible focus styling. Supplied browser evidence supports keyboard access and no storage creation; it does not establish a full accessibility audit.

Release gating is appropriate: the null manifest disables downloads, URLs are restricted to versioned assets in this repository, and no local ad-hoc ZIP is exposed. Manifest validation checks metadata shape—not signing, notarization, availability or authorization—which the README explicitly acknowledges. [macos-release.ts:13](src/lib/macos-release.ts:13), [README.md:73](macos/README.md:73).

**Release acceptance remains separate:** no public installer has been validated. Signed/notarized artifact verification, fresh-download installation, account/transfer acceptance and YouTube policy review remain prerequisites to enabling downloads. These do not block the current unavailable-download page. Build/test results were supplied, not independently rerun.
resolution: Parent fixed both findings directly: step 3 opens with the owner-account restriction and names the JSON alternative; a visible Bring your browser library panel describes export/import without login. Final build and page check follow. No revised score is claimed. This website review is separate from the prior native UI's 9.0/10 result.
